name: @mercatus-liber/customization
description: Per-region color/finish customization for made-to-order products (subsystem 27) -- a shared palette, ranked/priced finish tiers (one-color print up to hand-painted), and per-product color regions with real printing-process rules (a region too small to be its own physically separate part follows its parent region's color once a finish produces separate assembled parts; a region can restrict which palette colors are offered, e.g. a light-diffuser that must stay white for an LED to shine through). Ported faithfully from a real reference implementation (dostal-3d-printing/shop-assets/color/color-regions.json + its reference editor), not invented from scratch. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- resolveEffectiveColor/availableColorChoices are pure, I/O-free functions a storefront's own 3D-viewer UI calls directly; this package has no rendering/animation concern of its own, same separation @mercatus-liber/community-goals draws for its own progress numbers.
